purpose: Alexander Mosaic benchmark source provenance for deterministic mosaic generation

artwork.title: Alexander Mosaic, also known as the Battle of Issus Mosaic
artwork.date: Roman copy, circa 125-120 BCE, after an earlier Hellenistic painting traditionally attributed to Philoxenus of Eretria
artwork.publicDomainRationale: The underlying ancient mosaic is a two-dimensional artwork from antiquity and is outside copyright term in the United States and other jurisdictions with comparable public-domain treatment for ancient works. The selected source file is also marked Public domain by Wikimedia Commons.

assetPolicy.originalSourceStorage: Do not store source image bytes under apps/client, apps/server, public, dist, or other runtime bundle paths until an approved asset location is established.
assetPolicy.workingSourceStorage: Generated working files belong under offline/output/ or another non-runtime path and must remain reproducible from this manifest.

crop.description: Use the full source frame. No manual crop is applied before normalization.

normalizedWorkingSource.reproducibilityNote: The normalized source is generated output, not runtime source. Regenerate it from the original URL, checksum, crop, and recipe before producing benchmark tiles.
